native_result.query: How does the consideration of academic characteristics alter the effects of Socioeconomic Status and race on BA degree completion?
native_result.HypoA: When academic characteristics are considered, the effect of SES on BA degree completion is reduced and the effect of race is enlarged.
native_result.HypoB: Controlling for academic characteristics (cognitive ability scores and high school class standing) mediates and attenuates the positive effect of socioeconomic status (parental education and income) on BA completion and educational attainment by 40% to 57%, while shifting the estimated effects of Black and Hispanic racial/ethnic identity in a strongly positive direction, revealing an underlying minority educational attainment advantage once socioeconomic background and academic performance are held constant.
